evidence.conditions: The adjacent procurement item requests a written contractor statement; statement is limited to training a model for a new product.
evidence.quotation: no data is being used to train a model to be used in the development of a new product.
evidence.notes: Model-status attestation; read with D005-B008.

evidence.conditions: Applies where laws do not provide for tracking student behavior with AI cameras.
evidence.quotation: LEAs shall ensure the AI systems do not track student’s behaviors and are not used for profiling students.
evidence.notes: Conditional safeguard; does not establish a blanket prohibition in every jurisdiction.

evidence.conditions: Prohibits raw or processed/aggregated/transformed data from training a new system for a Contractor product, model, service, or offering; breach consequences are discretionary to the LEA.
evidence.quotation: expressly prohibited from using any data provided to it by the data providers
evidence.notes: Strong prohibition followed by discretionary material-breach remedies; model training, not a blanket ban on all district-specific use.

evidence.conditions: Customization or development for District-Specific Needs requires prior written LEA approval and compliance with applicable law and contract.
evidence.quotation: Any such use of the data for the District-Specific Needs shall be subject to prior written approval
evidence.notes: Exception to B011; not an unqualified prohibition.

evidence.conditions: Data use is limited to District-Specific Needs and requires prior written approval.
evidence.quotation: The customization and development of the AI System is expressly required by the (replace with the name of LEA) to meet the specific needs of the School District
evidence.notes: Vendor reuse is permitted only within the stated district-specific purpose and approval condition.

evidence.conditions: The LEA first submits a written request; Contractor then submits an RFA to the state.
evidence.quotation: the Contractor shall submit to the state, in writing, a Request for Approval (RFA) to use the data for AI System training
evidence.notes: Approval process, not itself a grant of training permission.

evidence.conditions: Written request for data use is submitted to the LEA.
evidence.quotation: The Contractor shall submit an RFA, in writing, to the (replace with the name of LEA) to use the data provided by the data providers for AI System training.
evidence.notes: Request is not approval.

evidence.conditions: Listed as information to be included in an RFA; no training authorization follows from the listing.
evidence.quotation: Data elements that will be used for the AI System training.
evidence.notes: Disclosure/request checklist rather than substantive permission.

evidence.conditions: RFA/model-training-completion statement must describe the listed details.
evidence.quotation: Specific types of data that will be used for model training.
evidence.notes: Training data is the subject of required reporting, not an independent prohibition.

evidence.conditions: The RFA must state duration; no specific duration is set in this block.
evidence.quotation: Duration of data usage.
evidence.notes: Reporting requirement does not itself prescribe a retention period.

evidence.conditions: Model-completion statement must address deletion or return by a certain date and whether data was stored; no date is specified here.
evidence.quotation: Deletion of training data or training data will be returned by a certain date.
evidence.notes: Checklist asks for deletion/return status; does not itself set the date.

evidence.conditions: Applies to data under the procurement document/contracts and to new products of Contractor, partners, or affiliates.

evidence.conditions: Specifically addresses new products of Contractor, partners, or affiliates; no statement about district-approved development appears in this block.
evidence.quotation: new product of the Contractor or any of its partners or affiliates.
evidence.notes: Vendor/affiliate reuse restriction is scoped to new products.

evidence.conditions: Avoid gathering, sharing, or disseminating personal information without consent; applies to others, including classmates and educators.
evidence.quotation: Avoid using AI tools to gather, share, or disseminate personal information without consent.

evidence.conditions: Model-policy template; prohibits student-data use for training public AI models.

evidence.quotation: vendor accountability for unauthorized use of student data.
